from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationRelation(BaseModel):
    """One paper's citation relationships to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title, as appears in the document")
    references_in_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers (from the collection) that this paper cites, as found in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated citation relations from all papers in the collection."""
    citation_relations: list[CitationRelation]
